resumo.en: Art direction, illustration and storyboard for a Neve and PlayGround documentary on bringing sanitation to people who live without it.

desafio.en:
Neve and PlayGround Brasil made a documentary about Banheiros Mudam Vidas, a program that backs low-cost sanitation, like biodigesters, in a country where half the people lack basic sanitation. My job was the look: illustrated scenes that kept the campaign's palette and textures.

The brief asked for a lot to look at in every scene. The deadline was short, and the art had to be easy for a small animation team to pick up and move.

processo.en:
I drew the concept and the storyboard by hand. Paper gives the line more weight and the compositions more structure. Because I animate, I drew with the motion already in mind.

The storyboard fixed the camera move for every scene, so I built one layout the camera could travel through, from one setting to the next. Then I finished each scene digitally, one by one, in files the animators could pick up and move fast on a short deadline. I also left a library of assets and textures, so the editors could keep building the film on their own.

resultado.en:
A 7-minute documentary released on PlayGround Brasil's YouTube channel in October 2020, directed by Wudd, Danilo Pontes and Leonardo Trintinalia, animated by Felipe Braidott and Leonardo Trintinalia.

The hand-drawn line made it through the digital finish and frames the people telling their stories.
